quotes: The South Ukraine NPP (SUNPP) reported the detection of six drones early on 5 July and three drones on 2 July.
The IAEA team at the Khmelnytskyy Nuclear Power Plant (KhNPP) heard military aircraft early on 8 July, and was later informed that drones were detected north of the site.
Separately, the ZNPP on 3 July temporarily lost all off-site power for the 21st time since the start of the conflict.
